name: Kale Salad with Bacon, Pineapple, Coconut & Orange Yogurt Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 bunches kale
1 ½ small pineapples

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, zest and juice oranges into a large bowl. Add yogurt, oil, vinegar, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
Wipe skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium heat. Add coconut and almonds; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup shredded unsweetened coconut
¾ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with bacon, coconut, and almonds. Enjoy!
